name: about
title: About, methodology and corrections
line: Who runs this project, how it is funded, how it verifies evidence, how it handles corrections, privacy and takedown requests.

name: changes
title: What changed
line: Every record added to this archive, every state that has moved, and every edit: with the date and the commit it landed in.

name: evidence
title: Evidence library
line: A searchable public archive of orders, statements, court documents, RTI replies, photographs, videos and eyewitness accounts. Every item has an ID and a source.

name: hi
title: यह अभिलेख क्या है
line: भारत में पुलिस बल-प्रयोग का एक सार्वजनिक अभिलेख, और यह प्रश्न कि उसे किसने अधिकृत किया। यह पृष्ठ बताता है कि इस अभिलेख को कैसे पढ़ें और दस्तावेज़ कैसे भेजें।

name: index
title: Who gave the order?
line: A public record of police use of force against students in India, with a source behind every line. No order authorising any of it has been found. Ask the offices that hold the records to preserve them, in two minutes, from this site.

name: investigation
title: Investigation
line: What happened, what evidence exists, whether any order has been found, what remains unknown, and how to ask the office that would hold the record to preserve it.

name: investigations
title: Investigations
line: Documented incidents of the use of state force against citizens, each with its evidence, its chain of authority and its open questions.

name: letters
title: Send a preservation letter
line: Four written requests asking Bihar police offices to preserve control-room logs, wireless logs and CCTV from the protests of 21 to 27 July 2026. Fill in your details and the letter opens in your mail window, addressed and ready to read.

name: others
title: The investigation is bigger than us
line: An index of credible work by journalists, researchers, lawyers, citizens and civil society organisations. Indexed and credited, never claimed as our own.

name: press
title: Press
line: What this archive is, what it currently holds, and how to quote it. Written for journalists, with the release available to download.

name: rti-kit
title: RTI kit
line: A drafted Right to Information application for every incident in the archive, asking for the orders, logs and permissions and never for reasons, with the office, portal and fee where we could verify them.

name: rti
title: The RTI log
line: Every Right to Information application filed on a question in this archive, and how to file one yourself. Start with a preservation letter, which puts a date on the notice before a retention cycle runs.

name: search
title: Search
line: Search across people, offices, locations, dates, incidents, evidence IDs, documents and keywords.

name: submit
title: Help find the order
line: Submit evidence to a public accountability archive. Nothing sent by the public goes live automatically: every submission is reviewed against its original source first.

name: default
title: Who gave the order?
line: A public record of police use of force in India, and the chain of authority behind it.
